title: Knowledge Network Viewer Project Knowledge Base
description: Machine-readable software blueprint and charter for the Knowledge Network Viewer (knowledge_network): a standalone interactive graph viewer that renders any project's knowledge.json as a navigable vis-network of modules, domain entities, schemas, workflows, functions, dependencies and known issues.

project_metadata.name: Knowledge Network Viewer (knowledge_network)
project_metadata.description: Standalone interactive viewer that turns a project knowledge.json into a 'nero network' (vis-network graph) of its structure, relationships and open issues.
project_metadata.purpose: Give non-specialist users and AI agents a one-glance visual map of a project's knowledge base so modules, domain concepts, dependencies and known issues are obvious and navigable.
project_metadata.status: Phase 0 — planning and repository compliance established (T00, 2026-10-01). No runtime code implemented yet; this knowledge base is the project inception charter.

key_modules: engine/build_knowledge_network.py (T02) - reads a target project's knowledge.json and emits a self-contained HTML with the graph data inlined (openable via file://, no server)
engine/graph_model.py (T01) - the canonical mapping knowledge.json -> {nodes, edges}; pure functions, unit-testable, no I/O
ui/knowledge_network.html (T03) - the generated viewer: vis-network canvas + shared common/universal_ui_design base + project CSS override; type filter, click-to-inspect side panel
cli/main.py or engine entry (T04) - parameter matrix: --source <path>, --out <path>, --filter <types>, --theme <name>
test/ (T05) - mapping unit tests on fixture knowledge.json; build-integration tests on web_tracer + eks knowledge.json; offline-open sanity check
data_flows: Target knowledge.json -> graph_model.py maps to {nodes, edges} by node/edge type
graph_model output -> build_knowledge_network.py inlines JSON into a vis-network HTML template
ui/knowledge_network.html -> browser renders interactive graph; user filters node types / clicks a node to inspect its source text
integration_points: Target projects: any <project>/knowledge.json (web_tracer/knowledge.json, eks/knowledge.json verified as fixtures)
Shared common/universal_ui_design.css + .js - base UI design system (5 themes, shell layout, toast/modal/file/table utils), project CSS overrides only (AGENTS.md §18)
vis-network - graph rendering library (CDN with documented offline fallback, Q2)
Python 3.10+ standard library for the builder (no heavy deps required for the inline-HTML approach)

core_entities: KnowledgeNetwork - the rendered graph: {nodes, edges, entry_points, hotspots, stats}
Node - a graph vertex typed by kind: project / module / entity / relation / term / schema / workflow / function / dependency / issue
Edge - a graph link typed by edge type: belongs_to / part_of / defines / uses / in / supports / affects / connects / references
ProjectHub - the root node (project_metadata.name) that every other node connects to
IssueNode - a known_issues entry, coloured red, with an affects edge to the module/entity it references
Hotspot - a high-degree node (many connections) auto-flagged in stats for emphasis
NodeType - the category used for colour + filter (one of the 10 kinds above)
EdgeType - the relationship category used for line style/label
relationships: belongs_to - a module/schema/workflow belongs to the project hub
part_of - a domain entity or term is part of the project's domain
defines - a schema defines/describes a module or entity
uses - a workflow or function uses a module (entry_point)
in - a function lives in a module
supports - a dependency (service/library/infra) supports the project or a module
affects - a known issue affects a module/entity
connects - a relationship-type concept connects the entities it names
references - a node references another node by name (loose link)
terminology: knowledge.json - the machine-readable project charter each project must carry (AGENTS.md §5.10)
nero network - the user's name for this knowledge-graph view (vis-network of a knowledge base)
vis-network - the JavaScript graph-rendering library used by the viewer
inline data - the knowledge.json graph is embedded in the HTML so it opens from file:// without a server
node type / edge type - the category driving colour, size and filter behaviour
shared UI design system - common/universal_ui_design.css + .js base layer (AGENTS.md §18)

key_schemas: Graph model spec (T01, planned) - this workplan §8.3 freeze of knowledge.json -> {nodes, edges}; not a JSON Schema file, a mapping contract

NOTE: AGENTS.md §2.4 references a shared config/schemas/knowledge_base_schema.json to validate knowledge.json; that shared schema is absent (web_tracer I003, blocked). knowledge_network therefore parses knowledge.json structurally and tolerates unknown keys; it does NOT require the shared schema to exist

workflows.name: Build a knowledge network for a project
phases: build_knowledge_network.render(template, graph) -> self-contained HTML with inlined data
open ui/knowledge_network.html in a browser (file://) and explore

functions: graph_model.map(kb) - pure mapping knowledge.json -> {nodes, edges} with node/edge typing
graph_model.node_id / edge_id helpers - stable ids for collapse/filter/inspect
build_knowledge_network.render(graph, template, theme) - emit HTML with inlined JSON + vis-network options
cli args: --source (required path to knowledge.json), --out (output html), --filter (comma list of node types to show), --theme (shared UI theme name)

data_flows.name: knowledge.json -> interactive graph
transformations: graph_model.map() builds nodes (project hub + modules + entities + relations + schemas + workflows + functions + dependencies + issues) and typed edges
build_knowledge_network.render() inlines the graph JSON into a vis-network HTML template using the shared UI base
Browser renders the graph; user filters node types and clicks nodes to inspect source text

data_quality_checks: Mapping must never crash on unknown keys (lenient structural parse)
Every node except the project hub has at least one edge (no orphans)
Generated HTML must be valid and open offline (file://) without a server
Build must succeed on both web_tracer/knowledge.json and eks/knowledge.json fixtures (T05)
Version field surfaced in the UI header; mismatch between knowledge.json version and rendered banner is flagged

layers: L1: Project structure validation - the ten required folders exist (T00 established)
L2: Source readability - --source knowledge.json is readable and valid JSON
L3: Output writability - --out directory is writable
L4: Dependency probe - vis-network available (CDN reachable) or offline fallback configured (Q2)
error_codes: KNV-SRC-001 - --source knowledge.json missing or not valid JSON
KNV-MAP-001 - unmappable knowledge.json shape (no project_metadata.name); render with a warning banner

external_services: vis-network CDN (unpkg/jsdelivr) for graph rendering; offline fallback via bundled copy or pyvis server mode (Q2)
libraries: Python 3.10+ standard library (json, argparse, pathlib) for the builder - no heavy back-end deps
pyvis (optional, T06) - alternative server-rendered mode if CDN is blocked
infrastructure: Any modern browser to open the generated HTML
Native Linux (current workstation); other OSes open the HTML equally

known_issues: KNV-I001 - Resolved 2026-10-01 (T00) - knowledge/ folder compliance: ten folders + knowledge.json + logs created

KNV-I002 - Needs Decision (Q2/Q3) - offline CDN policy and default --source: decide whether to bundle vis-network for true offline use, and what the default target knowledge.json should be when --source is omitted
Inherited - web_tracer I003 (blocked) - the shared knowledge_base_schema.json is absent, so knowledge_network parses structurally and does not validate against a schema; revisit if I003 closes
